messages:
Sam: FYI planning a rolling cordon + soft-reboot of the L1 GPU pool to address a NIC firmware thermal regression. Target maintenance window 04:00-07:00 UTC next Tue. Expected impact: transient 1-3% capacity reduction per cohort. No planned evictions for Dedicated customers; we'll drain non-critical pools only. Any objections? @Kaitlyn @Irene

Kaitlyn: Can we do a small canary first (4 nodes) to validate KV/prefix cache warmup and perf before wider waves? Also want per-wave backfill so we don't starve jobs. Suggest sequence: canary -> wave1 (20%) -> wave2 (40%) -> final (remaining).

Raj: For Dedicated customers can we pin traffic to alternate pool during their jobs? Also can someone estimate additional cost from temporary backfill/spot usage and possible SLA risk?

Irene: I'll take comms + status page update. Please point me at the runbook link and confirm the final window so I can post customer notice.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: INF-2026-1072. Initial schedule 03:00-06:00 UTC. Playbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra-l1-maintenance. Assigned: Sam, Kaitlyn, Raj, Irene.

Sam: Updated plan after discussion: shift window to 04:00-07:00 UTC to avoid APAC overlap per Maya. Canary 04:00-04:15, wave1 04:20-04:40, wave2 04:45-05:30, final 05:45-07:00. Steps per node: cordon -> drain -> soft reboot -> uncordon. Keep cohort sizes small in APAC racks. KV/prefix cache warmup target: 5m after uncordon. Example ops snippet: 
```bash
COHORT=(node-101 node-102 node-103 node-104)
for n in ${COHORT[@]}; do
  kubectl cordon $n
  kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
  ssh $n sudo systemctl reboot
  sleep 300
  kubectl uncordon $n
done
```

Sam: We'll attach an automatic rollback: if any cohort sees >5% 1m error rate or 50ms median latency spike vs baseline for >5m, abort and route to comp-model-1 variant. Also enabling conservative batching on affected hosts during the window.

Maya: Support flagged a small spike of 5xxs late last week for a subset of customers — moving window later to 04:00-07:00 UTC helps reduce APAC impact. Also recommend shrinking canary if we see any anomalous telemetry.

Sam: Acknowledged. Window moved to 04:00-07:00 UTC and ticket updated. Cohort plan adjusted for APAC racks (max 2 nodes per wave there).

Ben: ack. :thumbsup:

Irene: I'll draft the tenant notice and post it in #customer-success in ~30m after Sam confirms final copy. Will call out expected capacity reduction and fallback routing.

Sam: Final confirm: 04:00-07:00 UTC next Tue, canary starts 04:00. No objections by EOD -> we schedule run. I'll attach the rollback play and monitoring dashboard to INF-2026-1072.

ops-bot: INF-2026-1072 updated: window 04:00-07:00 UTC, cohorts defined, rollback policy attached, notification pending.
